com.esignal.jstandard.event

Interface ContentRequestListener

  • All Superinterfaces:
    java.util.EventListener

    public interface ContentRequestListener
extends java.util.EventListener
    The main purpose of this client implemented listener is to process the data objects for RESPONSE events.

    The client implemented listener could also listen to requested and error events. The clients should be processing these methods as fast as possible else it could impact the overall performance to their application.

    These are the key methods that the client is responsible for implementation, which provides Content information wrapped in the event object.

    Since:
    01-015-0000
    Author:
    Interactive Data
